info.title: PoYo AI - MiniMax H3 Image API
info.description: The MiniMax H3 Image API generates an image from a prompt or edits up to 16 reference images. It supports 1K, 2K, and 4K output, ten aspect ratios, and custom sizes up to 20 megapixels.

post.description: MiniMax H3 Image text-to-image generation and image editing with up to 16 reference images.

input.prompt: A vintage travel poster for Kyoto, headline text 'KYOTO' in large bold serif letters and subtitle 'City of a Thousand Gates' below, red torii gates receding up a mossy hill, autumn maple leaves, 1960s screen-print style
Place the sofa from <Picture 2> and the floor lamp from <Picture 3> in the empty living room in <Picture 1>. Keep the walls, windows, and daylight of <Picture 1> unchanged.
Minimal presentation background, soft gradient from deep navy to teal, subtle geometric lines in the lower right, large empty area on the left for text

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

model.description: MiniMax H3 Image model identifier. Omit image_urls for text-to-image; pass 1–16 image_urls for image editing.

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL for task completion or failure.

input.description: Generate one image. With image_urls, edit or combine the reference images.

prompt.description: Prompt describing the image or the requested edit. Must contain non-whitespace text. Put exact on-image text in quotes and state where it goes. In image editing, refer to reference images as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and so on.

image_urls.description: Optional 1–16 reference image URLs. Passing this field selects image editing. Must be an array, even for one image. Images are numbered by their order in the array: the first URL is <Picture 1>, the second is <Picture 2>, and so on; use these tags in the prompt to refer to each image. Each URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL pointing to a JPEG, PNG, or WEBP image of up to 20 MB, with each side between 128 and 8192 pixels.

size.description: Aspect ratio, auto, or custom WIDTHxHEIGHT. Aspect ratios: 1:1, 5:4, 4:5, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 16:9, 9:16, 21:9; their pixel size comes from resolution. auto applies to image editing and follows the aspect ratio of <Picture 1> at about the pixel area of the selected resolution tier. Custom WIDTHxHEIGHT uses integers with total pixels from 655360 to 20000000 and an aspect ratio between 1:3 and 3:1 (for example 2560x1440); the output has exactly the requested width and height. Defaults to 1:1 for text-to-image and auto for image editing.

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Expand the prompt into a detailed description of the whole image before generating. Applies to text-to-image requests. Image editing requests always expand the prompt.

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier for status tracking

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`

created_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was created
